02 / Twice-weekly edit

THIS WEEK,
BEYOND THE OBVIOUS

Three free or unusually good-value London events, selected for access, local character and a story worth following.

01 Free

Fri 27 Nov · 10:00–22:00

Rilès: ALL LOVE at BSMT Gallery

Watch through BSMT's gallery window as Rilès hand-copies the Bible by day, then composes a new album in the same room each evening: a durational work built on repetition and attention.

Where
BSMT Gallery, Hackney
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
02 Free entry; optional paid activities

Sat 28 Nov · 12:00–17:00

Cody Dock Frost Fair

Cody Dock revives the Thames frost-fair tradition beside the lower Lea with local makers, winter crafts, live music, a children's lantern procession and a new ironwork installation.

Where
Cody Dock, Newham
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
03 Free

Sat 28 Nov – Sun 29 Nov

Studio Pottery London Open Studio Weekend

A working Belgravia pottery studio opens for one weekend, bringing visitors face to face with 30 ceramic artists, their processes and handmade work in the place where it is made.

Where
Studio Pottery London, City of Westminster
Access
Booking recommended
Check details ↗
